design.status_of_evidence: CONFIRMATORY for the generality of the PMIS estimand: Lee2019 (54 healthy participants, independent of HS-Stroke) has never been analysed by this project; no PMIS outcome on it exists
design.data: GigaDB doi:10.5524/100542 (Lee et al. 2019, GigaScience giz002; GigaDB datasets CC0); 20 sensorimotor channels; trial-local causal 4th-order Butterworth 8-30 Hz; MI window [cue, cue+4 s); OAS covariance
design.injection: no natural duplicates (build audit: 0 exact duplicate raw MI windows); a' is a bit-identical copy of held-out trial a added as one extra training row
design.split: within participant, leave-one-run-out (4 runs x 100 trials); base C = the other 300 trials
design.pairs: per (participant, held-out run, class): outcome-blind random 40 of 50 trials matched into 20 pairs, 10 untouched bystanders; 160 pairs per participant, 8,640 in total
design.placebo: per pair: c != e random base trials of the same session (other run) and class; random sign
design.model: vendored R4 TS+LR: multiplicity-weighted Karcher reference recomputed per arm, tangent space, L2 LR C = 1 solved to the exact optimum (damped Newton); the G3 sklearn-lbfgs estimator is also fitted for the A/B arms (S3)
design.aggregation: G3 rule: pair value -> class-balanced participant value -> mean over 54 participants

hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.H1_primary: d_TSLR (exact-optimum per-arm refit) differs from 0 on Lee2019; participant-level two-sided Monte Carlo sign-flip (1e6 draws, seed 7499) and t95 CI over 54 participants; expected direction > 0
hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.H2_influence_law: the parameter-free one-Newton-step prediction from the base model reproduces the exact effect: participant-mean ratio prediction/exact in [0.8, 1.25] AND pair-level Pearson r >= 0.9
hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.no_SESOI: no equivalence region and no post-hoc relevance threshold
